title: Conversation on Computer Art — सुरभि / Surabhi (Doordarshan)
license: Cinema Vision India — all rights reserved (as found)
notes: Surabhi feature, U-matic hi-band master, 21.04.1991, English: Luku Sanyal with the painter Akbar Padamsee and Atul on what a computer does to a painting. Windows 1-2 Padamsee in the computer room, then a burst of video breakup and his own portrait resolving on a CRT; 3 more breakup over a paint-program figure study; 4 and 6 the operator at the workstation; 5 (long) Sanyal to camera. The red-painting sequence and the tape's last two minutes carry no audio and are not used. Cut from spans fetched over ncaa.gov.in's iOS HLS path (iPhone User-Agent required); un-fetched spans are black filler so the timeline - and srcWindows - match the original tape.
